analystRationale: FOMC 決策前的升息機率仍顯著，油價雖因美伊暫停攻擊而急跌，但荷莫茲海峽尚未恢復通行；同時，Nvidia、PHLX 半導體指數與亞洲記憶體股同步承壓，顯示 AI 基礎建設融資與中國競爭疑慮正跨市場傳導。本週大型科技財報與美國 GDP、PCE 又將集中公布，因此定性維持 High Alert，但不把尚未公布的數據方向先行寫入確認規則。

evidence.title: 2026 FOMC meeting calendar
evidence.summary: The Federal Reserve's official calendar lists a two-day FOMC meeting on July 28-29, 2026.

evidence.title: Stocks drift on Wall Street and crude oil prices drop as Mideast tensions cool
evidence.summary: AP reported a mixed July 27 U.S. close, a nearly 36% perceived probability of a Fed rate increase, lower Treasury yields, sharply lower oil settlements, and weakness in Nvidia and Micron.

evidence.title: Mediators make progress in US-Iran negotiations to prevent Middle East war
evidence.summary: AP reported progress by mediators and no U.S. or Iranian attacks for three days, while the Strait of Hormuz remained closed and regional drone threats persisted.

evidence.title: Wall Street ends mixed as investors focus on tech earnings
evidence.summary: Reuters reported the S&P 500 nearly flat, Nasdaq down 0.18%, PHLX semiconductor index down 2.2%, Nvidia down about 5%, and Brent down about 8% on July 27.

evidence.title: Korean chip stocks tumble with SK Hynix below US listing price amid China competition fears
evidence.summary: Reuters reported that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell as much as 9.5% and 11.1% in July 28 Asian trading amid concerns about AI infrastructure financing and intensifying Chinese competition.

evidence.title: China begins making homegrown DUV chipmaking tools, The Information reports
evidence.summary: Reuters relayed a report that China had begun limited production of domestic immersion DUV tools, while noting that performance, reliability, manufacturer identity, and mass-production readiness remained unresolved.

evidence.title: China memory chipmaker CXMT's shares soar in a blockbuster share listing in Shanghai
evidence.summary: AP reported that CXMT shares rose 466% in their July 27 Shanghai debut and that the company remained constrained by limited access to advanced chipmaking equipment.

evidence.title: Microsoft announces quarterly earnings release date
evidence.summary: Microsoft said it will publish fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter results after the market close on July 29, 2026, followed by a conference call at 2:30 p.m. Pacific Time.

evidence.title: Meta Q2 2026 earnings call
evidence.summary: Meta's investor calendar schedules its second-quarter 2026 earnings call for July 29, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time.

evidence.title: Amazon.com to webcast second-quarter 2026 financial results conference call
evidence.summary: Amazon scheduled its second-quarter 2026 results conference call for July 30, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.

evidence.title: Apple investor updates
evidence.summary: Apple's investor page schedules its fiscal third-quarter results call for July 30, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.

evidence.title: U.S. Consumer Confidence Index release schedule
evidence.summary: The Conference Board schedules the next U.S. Consumer Confidence Index release for July 28, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time.

evidence.title: Tentative auction schedule of U.S. Treasury securities
evidence.summary: The Treasury schedule lists a seven-year note auction for July 28, 2026, with settlement on July 31.

evidence.title: BEA 2026 release schedule
evidence.summary: BEA schedules the advance estimate of second-quarter 2026 GDP and the June 2026 Personal Income and Outlays report for July 30 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time.

events.headline: FOMC 今日開會，市場仍保留顯著升息機率
events.summary: Fed 官方日程確認 7 月 28–29 日召開 FOMC；AP 報導截至美股 7 月 27 日收盤，市場認為本次升息機率接近 36%，顯示政策結果仍非單一路徑。
transmissionPath: 美國短端利率重新定價
events.interpretation: 若兩年期殖利率代理指標上升至少 5 個基點，才視為鷹派政策風險進一步被市場確認；決議公布前不預判升息或維持利率。

events.headline: 美伊暫停攻擊推低 Brent 與 WTI，但荷莫茲仍未解封
events.summary: AP 報導美伊已連續三天未互相攻擊，調停方稱談判取得進展；Brent 10 月期貨 7 月 27 日收跌 6.3% 至每桶 85.87 美元，WTI 9 月期貨收跌 7.5% 至 82.61 美元，但荷莫茲海峽仍關閉且區域無人機威脅持續。
transmissionPath: 全球股票與台灣進口成本
events.interpretation: 油價續跌才支持供應風險與通膨壓力持續降溫；海峽仍關閉代表目前只是戰爭溢價回吐，不能等同能源物流已正常化。

events.headline: AI 與半導體賣壓擴散至亞洲，台灣科技供應鏈面臨風險偏好檢驗
events.summary: Reuters 報導 Samsung Electronics 與 SK Hynix 在 7 月 28 日亞洲交易時段一度下跌 9.5% 與 11.1%；前一個美股交易日 Nvidia 跌約 5%、PHLX 半導體指數跌 2.2%。市場同時消化 AI 基礎建設融資疑慮、中國國產 DUV 設備報導，以及 CXMT 上市首日上漲 466% 所反映的競爭變化。
transmissionPath: AI 融資與中國競爭疑慮
Nvidia、晶片設備與記憶體股估值下修
亞洲半導體風險偏好下降
台灣晶圓代工與供應鏈評價
events.interpretation: 若 SOXX 與 0050 同步達到下跌門檻，才視為半導體風險已從海外個股擴散至台灣大型權值股；中國 DUV 設備的性能、可靠度與量產時程尚未公開，不把技術突破本身當成已證實事實。

events.headline: Microsoft、Meta、Amazon 與 Apple 財報將集中檢驗 AI CapEx 回報
events.summary: 公司投資人關係頁面顯示 Microsoft 與 Meta 將於 7 月 29 日公布或討論季度結果，Amazon 與 Apple 排定 7 月 30 日；Reuters 指出投資人正聚焦大型科技公司的 AI 支出與現金流指引。
transmissionPath: 大型科技公司營收與 AI 成長
資料中心 CapEx 與自由現金流
台灣伺服器與晶片供應鏈
events.interpretation: 財報公布前沒有可誠實設定的單一方向性市場代理；應直接檢查營收、雲端或 AI 成長、CapEx 與自由現金流，而不是預設 QQQ 或 SOXX 的方向。

events.headline: 美國消費信心、公債標售、GDP 與 PCE 形成密集宏觀資料窗
events.summary: The Conference Board 排定 7 月 28 日美東時間上午 10 時發布消費者信心指數；美國財政部排定同日標售七年期公債；BEA 將於 7 月 30 日美東時間上午 8 時 30 分同步發布第二季 GDP 初值與 6 月個人所得及支出報告。
transmissionPath: 消費信心、GDP 與 PCE 結果
七年期公債需求與期限溢酬
events.interpretation: 這些結果可能同時改變成長、通膨與期限溢酬，但公布前無法指定誠實的共同方向，因此不設定市場確認規則，待實際數據與標售結果出爐後再判讀。
